sourceChanged: The source or title changed. Select it again in the editor.
saveWaiting: You can send an AI request once the document is saved.
promptSummary: Summarize the key points of this page.
promptTranslate: Translate this page into {{language}}, preserving its meaning and order.
promptInsights: Analyze this page and explain the main insights with evidence. Label any claims not supported by the document as speculation.
promptTracker: Create a task table from this page with task, owner, deadline and status. Mark information not found in the document as unspecified.
written: Written below the current block. You can edit it directly in the document.
connectNotice: Connect an AI account to get started.
question: Question
selectionHint: Adds new blocks below the selected source.
scopeHint: Only the current document text or selected text is sent. Images, attachments and other documents are excluded.
scopeLabel: AI scope: current document or selected text
sendHint: Sending shares the current scope with AI and writes below the block.
personalOnly: AI is available in personal mode.
connectionInfo: Connect Document AI with a separate ChatGPT account. It may use your ChatGPT plan allowance. Document content is sent only when you press Send in the editor.
secretsInfo: API keys and Codex login credentials are not imported. There is no automatic switch to another paid provider.
loginHint: Complete sign-in and authorize plan usage, then press “Check connection” here.
modelPlaceholder: Choose a model available to your account
revokePending: Disconnected locally, but remote revocation could not be confirmed. Also disconnect the app in ChatGPT settings.
error_request: The AI request failed. Check your connection and try again.
error_savingOrChanged: The source or title is not saved yet or has changed. Reload the source.
error_cannotWrite: The source or title changed, or blocks cannot be written. Reload the current document and try again.
error_connectFirst: Connect or sign in to your ChatGPT account again in AI settings.
error_chooseModel: Choose an available model in AI settings.
error_expired: The request expired. Start again in the app.
error_accountChanged: The AI account or model changed. Prepare the request again.
error_selection: Select up to 20,000 characters from the current document.
error_input: Enter what you want to write.
error_limit: Your ChatGPT usage limit was reached. Check your allowance in ChatGPT settings.
error_busy: Too many pending AI requests. Try again shortly.
error_oauth: ChatGPT authorization could not be verified. Sign in and authorize plan usage again.
error_oauthCancelled: ChatGPT sign-in was canceled. Your existing connection is preserved.
error_providerUnavailable: Cannot reach the AI provider. Check your connection and try again.
error_providerHttp: AI provider request failed (HTTP {{status}}). Check your sign-in and allowance.
error_incomplete: No completed AI result was received. The source is preserved. Check your connection and allowance.
error_tooLarge: The AI response exceeded the size limit. Try a smaller request.
error_permission: You do not have permission to use this document.
error_loopbackOnly: Complete a new AI sign-in in the local connection window on your computer. For a remote server, start the SSH tunnel and local login bridge described in the installation guide first. Once connected, you can use AI from your phone and the usual HTTPS address.
localConnectionInfo: Complete a new AI sign-in in the local connection window on your computer. For a remote server, start the SSH tunnel and local login bridge described in the installation guide first. Once connected, you can use AI from your phone and the usual HTTPS address.
remoteReadyTitle: AI is ready on this server
remoteReadyInfo: ChatGPT is connected to this server. Use AI from your phone or computer at the server address you are using now.
remoteSetupInfo: No ChatGPT account is currently connected to this server. Connect once on a computer, then use AI from this same server address on your phone.
computerConnectionGuide: How to connect another account on a computer
computerOnlyAddress: Computer-only address · do not open on your phone
backgroundRunning: Writing on the server. You can close this window or open another document.
backgroundResultHeld: The document changed or insertion was unavailable. Your generated result is preserved.
error_backgroundInterrupted: Generation was interrupted by an app server restart. It was not called again automatically. Please submit a new request.
error_backgroundFailed: The AI task could not be completed. Your original document is preserved.
connectionUnknown: Unable to check the ChatGPT connection
disconnectConfirmation: Disconnect this account from this server? AI using this account will stop on every connected phone and computer. Connecting it again requires signing in on a computer.
